# Infinity Enterprise India

> Infinity Enterprise India is one enterprise operating across construction, electrical, IT and security, technology, manufacturing, waste management, sanitation, export, food processing and agri business.

Infinity Enterprise India is the official name of the enterprise. On the website the wordmark reads Infinity Enterprise, with India set smaller beneath it. The public site is https://infinityenterprisesindia.com.

## Identity

- Name: Infinity Enterprise India
- Also known as: Infinity Enterprise
- Website: https://infinityenterprisesindia.com
- Country: India
- Email: connect@infinityenterprise.in
- Tagline: One enterprise. Infinite possibilities.

## Businesses

- [Construction](https://infinityenterprisesindia.com/#/business/construction): Building the physical world.
- [Electrical](https://infinityenterprisesindia.com/#/business/electrical): Power. Systems. Installation.
- [IT & Security Solutions](https://infinityenterprisesindia.com/#/business/it-security): Networks. Security. Systems.
- [Technology](https://infinityenterprisesindia.com/#/business/technology): Software. AI. Digital systems.
- [Manufacturing](https://infinityenterprisesindia.com/#/business/manufacturing): Engineering production at scale.
- [Waste Management](https://infinityenterprisesindia.com/#/business/waste-management): Systems for shared places.
- [Sanitation & Hygiene](https://infinityenterprisesindia.com/#/business/sanitation): Cleaner operations. Better environments.
- [Export](https://infinityenterprisesindia.com/#/business/export): Connecting business beyond borders.
- [Food Processing](https://infinityenterprisesindia.com/#/business/food-processing): From raw material to product.
- [Agri Business](https://infinityenterprisesindia.com/#/business/agri-business): From land to value.
